learning_outcomes.text: Acquire a general understanding of mathematics and natural sciences and develop analytical thinking habits.
Develop a knowledge base in fundamental topics related to Electrical-Electronics Engineering.
Acquire the ability to identify, define, formulate, and solve engineering problems, and the competence to select and apply appropriate analysis and modeling methods for this purpose.
Acquire the ability and skill to analyze and design systems.
Transform theoretical knowledge into practical applications through laboratory and project work.
Effectively use current software and hardware.
Acquire the skill to work individually and as part of a team.
Acquire verbal and written communication skills. Effectively use a foreign language in professional life.
Awareness of the necessity of lifelong learning; ability to access information, follow developments in science and technology, and continuously renew oneself.
Acquire professional responsibility and ethical awareness.

syllabus_topics: Structure of Turkish industry, energy consumption
Boiler types, increasing energy efficiency in boilers
Energy saving in electric motors, lighting, pumps and fans
Economic analysis methods, evaluation of investment projects
Environmental Law, Environmental and Energy Relations
Evaluation of alternative energy potential in Turkey
Combined heat and power generation systems, cogeneration
